categories.main_business_segments: Union Semiconductor (Hefei) Co., Ltd. primarily engages in high-end advanced packaging and testing services for integrated circuits, focusing on display driver chips. The company provides full-process packaging and testing services including bumping, wafer testing, chip-on-glass (COG), and chip-on-film (COF) packaging. Its products mainly serve LCD, OLED, and AMOLED display panels used in smartphones, HDTVs, laptops, tablets, automotive electronics, and wearable devices.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company specializes in advanced packaging technologies such as gold bumping, glass and film chip-on packaging, wafer grinding and thinning, high-precision wafer dicing, and inner lead bonding. It employs high-density fine-pitch flip-chip packaging techniques and has developed proprietary processes to achieve high integration, miniaturization, and reliability. The firm is expanding into copper-nickel-gold and palladium bumping processes to reduce costs and enhance competitiveness.
categories.primary_customers_markets: Key customers are integrated circuit design companies specializing in display driver chips. The end markets include major display panel manufacturers like BOE, Visionox, and AU Optronics, serving consumer electronics such as smartphones, high-definition TVs, tablets, laptops, automotive displays, and smart wearables. The company’s customer base includes leading chip design firms in the display driver segment.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company operates primarily in China, with headquarters and manufacturing facilities in Hefei and a wholly-owned subsidiary in Yangzhou. Its sales are divided between domestic and overseas markets, with approximately 60% of revenue from international customers, mainly in Taiwan and other Asian regions. The company benefits from its location in the Yangtze River Delta, a major integrated circuit industry cluster.
categories.supply_chain_position: Union Semiconductor operates in the midstream segment of the semiconductor supply chain, focusing on outsourced semiconductor assembly and testing (OSAT) services. It does not engage in chip design or wafer fabrication but provides critical packaging and testing services to chip design companies, enabling the integration and final assembly of semiconductor products.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: The company’s strategic focus is on advancing packaging technologies, expanding 12-inch wafer advanced packaging capacity, and developing new bumping processes such as copper-nickel-gold and palladium to reduce reliance on gold. It invests heavily in R&D to improve yield, reliability, and production efficiency, and is actively exploring high-end packaging technologies like Fan-out, 2.5D/3D, and system-in-package (SiP). The firm also targets growth in automotive-grade chips and storage chip packaging.
categories.revenue_model: Revenue is generated primarily through customized packaging and testing service fees charged to integrated circuit design companies. The company operates on an OSAT model, providing end-to-end packaging and testing services based on customer wafer inputs and specifications. Pricing is based on material costs (notably gold usage) plus processing fees, negotiated per customer order and product complexity.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: Union Semiconductor is among the leading advanced packaging and testing service providers in China, especially in the display driver chip segment. It competes with established global OSAT firms such as ASE Group, Amkor Technology, JCET, TFME, and Hua Tian Technology, as well as emerging domestic players expanding capacity. The company holds a strong position with proprietary technologies and a growing market share in the advanced packaging niche.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: In 2024, the company reported revenue of approximately RMB 1.5 billion, a 21.22% increase year-over-year, with net profit attributable to shareholders of RMB 159.76 million, down 18.48%. Total assets grew 27.67% to RMB 4.59 billion, and net assets increased 2.2% to RMB 3.2 billion. The firm is in a growth phase, expanding capacity through convertible bond-funded projects and increasing R&D investment, while facing margin pressure due to rising costs and competitive pricing.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: Union Semiconductor emphasizes its advanced, high-precision packaging technologies with high integration density and fine pitch bumping, enabling smaller, lighter, and more reliable display driver chips. Its full-process packaging and testing integration reduces contamination risks and shortens delivery cycles. The company’s strong customer relationships, high product yield (>99.9%), and location within a major semiconductor cluster provide competitive advantages in quality, cost control, and responsiveness.
